profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Kirby
profile.summary: Highly skilled and experienced .NET software developer with a strong background in designing and building complex software systems. Proficient in C#, VB.Net, Angular,  ASP.NET, Azure, AWS, and MVC, with experience in a variety of industries including oil & gas midstream, real estate and e-commerce. Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained software systems using a variety of technologies, including AWS, C#, 
        .Net Core and Angular.
•	Developed microservices using REST and JSON, and containerized applications/services using 
        Docker.
•	Worked closely with product owners, designers, and developers to ensure timely delivery of 
        features to customer facing site (Familytreedna.com)
•	Maintained and updated existing software systems, including debugging, and troubleshooting 
        issues as needed.
•	Utilized AWS services such as S3, Neptune, RabbitMQ, DynamoDB to build scalable and reliable 
        cloud-based applications.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained software systems using C#, Azure, Telerik, .Net Core, and MVC for the Land Records, Division Order and Litigation departments.
•	Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design software solutions to meet business needs.
•	Design technical architecture for upgrading Captiva Capture enterprise content management system from 5.2 to 7.0
•	Re-platformed legacy VB6 applications to .Net Core MVC stack to align with the department’s goal of standardizing on Microsoft technologies.
•	Lead team in software architectural design sessions.
•	Removed the dependency of vendors saving the company over $100K annually in expenses by architecting solutions to utilize internal existing document management systems instead of Documentum.
•	Created and supported Azure CI/CD pipelines to manage deployments.
•	Participated in code reviews and contributed to the continuous improvement of software development processes.

positions.title: Systems Analyst\Developer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for managing the overall systems\production operations of the Imaging department.
•	Designed desktop applications and dynamic websites using ASP.Net, VB.Net and WPF.
•	Developed E-Stack windows application using VB.NET that allows users to identify documents at a page level based on the document list provided by client. The project was integrated with Captiva Capture as the front end and SQL Server on the backend.
•	Architect and developed WFMS (WorkFlow Manangement System) that is Stewart primary enterprise application use to obtain and process title insurance policy and accounting data. The application utilizes forms, reports, queries, VBA code and macros.

positions.title: Software Engineer at Schlumberger
positions.description:
•	Analyse, design, develop, maintain products, and assist in their commercialization - in agreement with project technical and timing objectives pertaining to QTrac.
•	Assist in identifying and organizing requirements and producing specifications.
•	Developed updates to QTrac internal website using JavaScript, jQuery, Web Services, C# as front-end technologies, and SQL Server 2008 as backend.
•	Design, created and performed updates to tables, views, stored procedures and triggers in SQL Server 2008
•	Provide timely corrective actions on all assigned defects and issues.
•	Gather mathematical calculation specifications from engineers and create them as validation functions.
